title: Rahul Gandhi: India's opposition rallies against voter roll revision exercise
paragraphs: Tens of thousands of people have gathered in Delhi for a major opposition rally demanding the resignation of India's chief election commissioner and electoral reforms.

The rally, organised by the main opposition Congress party and led by Rahul Gandhi, is taking place at Ramlila Maidan, a large ground in central Delhi known for hosting political rallies and protests.

Visuals showed Gandhi in an open-top jeep alongside other opposition leaders heading towards the venue. The Gen Z-led pressure group Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) has also pledged support, though its leaders have yet to be seen.
